capabilities: Draw lines, circles, rectangles and freehand scribbles on a canvas
Select, move, resize, copy and style shapes
Edit the raw SVG source in a code mode with error checking
Convert inline svg code blocks to .svg file embeds and back
Save drawings back into the note or the .svg file
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it includes a built-in self-test command that writes a report note.
problem: Obsidian displays svg code blocks as source text and .svg files as static images, with no way to edit the drawings directly in the vault.
summary: Visual SVG editor that renders ```svg code blocks and embedded .svg files as editable drawings, with a code mode for the raw source.
